focus_areas: Legibility and character-level confidence of text on the device casing
Structural integrity and boundary sharpness of the hinge mechanism
Material classification of the eyepiece (hard plastic vs rubber)
Realism of lens reflections and curvature
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side of the loupe; AI generators often fail to render crisp, meaningful text on small objects. Also, verify that the hinge area does not show signs of 'melting' where the two halves of the device meet, and confirm that the eyepiece lacks a rubber cup.
image_description: A close-up view of a black, folding jeweler's loupe. The device features a circular lens housing on the left and a protective casing on the right, connected by a hinge mechanism. White text is visible on the side of the casing. The background is plain white.
